impact: Confirms AI labs are buying on-site, behind-the-meter power at scale, which supports demand for BE's fuel cells and CAT/GEV gear, but it also shows gas turbines and recips competing for the same on-site orders BE targets.
summary: The FT reports Anthropic agreed to pay about $3.4B for 1.7GW of heavy-duty gas generators from OnePWR Solutions, taking over OnePWR's existing Caterpillar orders. It is the largest known single power-equipment purchase by an AI lab; units are due within about two years and sites are undisclosed. Both companies declined to comment.
title: Anthropic pays $3.4B for 1.7GW of gas generators
